name: Milk Yellow Box Zones
description: Forward-looking price levels derived from prior-day order flow. Zones are mapped at 9:30 AM ET before the open and placed AHEAD of price as pre-committed decision points: 'if price reaches here, do X'. Immutable once RTH opens.

rules.milkOk_definition: Price is inside or has broke through a zone on a CLOSED candle — low reached zone or broke through it, close held above zone bottom.
rules.zone_types: is_bull=true means support_zone (long signals). is_bull=false means resistance_zone (downgrade).
rules.support_zone: Zone below current price where buyers stepped in — is_bull=true.
rules.resistance_zone: Zone above current price where sellers stepped in — is_bull=false.
rules.resistance_downgrade: Resistance zone bottom within 5.0 pts above entry -> mandatory one-tier downgrade.
rules.no_time_only_check: Never mark milkOk based on time alone — always require price confirmation.
rules.zone_persistence: Zones do NOT reset daily. They persist from from_ts to to_ts regardless of day boundaries.
rules.price_comparison_only: Always compare prices (numbers) to prices. Never compare visual chart positions.
rules.zones_are_forward_looking: Zones are placed AHEAD of price before 9:30 AM ET. They are decision points: 'if price reaches here, what do I do?' — not reactive marks drawn after price moved.
rules.derived_from_prior_day: Zones are built from the previous day's order flow data in MotiveWave. Today's zones reflect yesterday's institutional positioning.
rules.pre_market_commitment: ALL zones for the day must be mapped before 9:30 AM ET (RTH open). No mid-session zone additions.
rules.zone_immutability: Once RTH opens, zones are LOCKED. No zone may be moved, adjusted, extended, shrunk, or removed during the trading day.
rules.no_hindsight_repositioning: A zone repositioned after price moved is invalid data. Exclude from signal generation and learning engine training.
rules.to_ts_fixed: Zone expiry (to_ts) is set at creation time and does not move. Zones are not extended because price kept respecting them.
rules.predictive_value: A zone placed BEFORE price reached it that price then respected is a valid signal. A zone moved after the fact is worthless.
rules.miss_is_information: If price blows through a zone without reacting, that is a valid miss — log it for the learning engine. Do not redraw to chase price.

min_confidence_riskiest: RISKIEST signals suppressed until win rate recovers above 40%
